rules.reason: Being unable to keep fluids down risks dehydration.
Signs of dehydration need same-day assessment.
Blood in the stool needs same-day assessment.
Vomiting or diarrhoea in a child under 2 for a day or more.
The person rates the illness as severe.
Fever with vomiting or diarrhoea for two days or more.
Symptoms lasting three days or more.
The person rates the illness as moderate.

warning_signs: Symptoms lasting more than 2 to 3 days
source_notes: Rules are student-authored from the general principles in public triage guidance (NHS emergency advice, ESI handbook, WHO emergency triage). Source clause references still to be added; NOT clinically validated.
